name: OSLO'S NICEST APARTMENT WITH ROOF TERRACE
description:
The space
- View over the city and the skyline. Extremely central, yet quiet. Shared roof terrace. Green area. Fast internet connexion. Lots of space, 58 square meters. New kitchen and bathroom. One large bedroom with a big double bed, and one for 1-2 guests.
You're of course welcome to use the kitchen as much as you want. Towels are provided. I always leave coffee and tea, two French press coffee makers. All utensils needed for cooking, and a blender if you feel like making a smoothie.
If you need a washing machine, it's in the basement, and it would be good for me to know beforehand because I'll have to book a slot (2 hours) to make sure no one else is using it at the time. Often no one's using their slot though, but if you want to try and see if it's available , please let me know so that I can let you know about availability etc.!

I'm open-minded and easy to talk to if you want advice or help to figure out about public transport, eating out, clubs
host_about:
From Oslo, Norway. I have a Master in Translation of Literature from French, a  passion for literature, art, film, music, science ... I've lived in London, Mozambique, La Réunion, Paris, Aix-en-Provence, Oxford and a couple of places in South America.
I love to experience new places and speak 5 languages.
I'm currently not really sure where I live. But perhaps mostly London!

I am a writer, translator & photographer. When in Oslo, I stay in this quiet and centrally located artist´s place. I will be available to you when you let me know that you  want me to. I will, however, not disturb an independent traveller. Let me know what you need and want. 

I am fond of music: jazz, classical, folk, Indian and European. Am fond of cinema too, and, of course, of books. I am certainly fond of, and curious about, people. 

I am deeply concerned about the destruction of nature and the climate systems we all depend on. 

I know my part of the city well, the green lungs and the streets, some the museums, the East End as well as the West End of the city. My place is located in the Centre, just to the west of the river that runs through the city.

When not in Oslo, I am most of the time committed to folk song and folk art projects in eastern parts of India and northern parts of Bangladesh, dedicated to amazing and vanishing traditions, be it in song or in yoga and colours. I am committed to artists and children there. I also have a special connection to Central-Eastern Europe, especially Budapest, where I usually spend a month every year, mainly concentrating on photography - or on a manuscript.

name: Central and design savvy flat, month of july rent!
description: If you´ve always wondered how you compare to the worlds tallest man (Robert Wadlow) - my place is perfect for you.  The black kitchen wall is his exact height - while simultaneously being an homage to a now torn down Japanese police station designed by the inspiring architect Sejima of Sanaa.  The apartment is full of spatial experiments like this one.  My place is close to (among other jewels) the St.Hanshaugen Park. My place is good for couples, solo adventurers, and business travelers.
host_about:
I work and live in the city of Oslo, and practice as an architect - hence the customized apartment.  My house is an attempt to optimize by staging every activity done here, from cooking, reading in the library  - sketching on a project or quietly contemplating life´s small and large events.  Balance is key!

Other than enjoying a life as an architect, I spend most weekends with friends or family - hopefully traveling somewhere soothing, enjoying the company, making a thing out of it!  To put the cherry on the pie - yes, I also own a classic car.  Now realizing as I write this - I´m as ordinary as any architect could be. 

On my door is one of my few everlasting motto´s : No rain, no potatoes.  

I grew up on a farm - but also in the Malaysian city of Kuala Lumpur.  While living there as a kid, the custom of meeting people with an open-minded smile was most inspiring - something I try to remind myself of when hosting people or traveling about.

Hope you´ll enjoy my apartment!

Hello,

My name is Marcus and I live in Oslo with my wife Mana. I am a traveller and travel as often as i can. I always favour private accommodation over expensive hotels or run down youth hostels when i travel and therefore I know exactly what a city traveler wants and expects from a stay.  The apartment have been designed and fitted with this in mind.

Both Mana and myself are Medical doctors, we are tidy, quiet and respectful towards others.

If you chose to stay at our place Mana or I will meet you in person to provide a short tour of the studioflat and amenities and hand over the keys. Afterwards the flat is all yours! 

I love Oslo, I it has colorful cafes, trendy restaurants, beautiful parks, seaside, lakes AND mountains within walking distance! The new design architecture of Bjørvika and Tjuvholmen and the statuepark of Wigelandsparken are always very popular among visitors. Our aim is to make your stay here in Oslo as pleasant and trouble free as possible. We hope that you chose to stay again when you next visit our fair city.

Kind regards,
Mana & Marcus

name: Velholdt eldre hus med kort vei til strand og by
description:
Older house with charm and good facilities.
In this place your family can stay close to everything, the location is central to Oslo city center.
The house is on 2 floors. There are bedrooms, bathrooms and laundry rooms downstairs. There is also a small garden to relax in on hot days.

The upper floor offers a living room, kitchen and a lovely balcony with plenty of space.
Here you can enjoy the view with barbecue and relaxation.

host_about:
Hei!

Jeg er en dame med mange jern i ilden. Og trives med dette:)
Jeg liker å være ute i skog og mark, på sjøen og til fjells. Det finnes ikke dårlig vær, bare dårlig klær.

Jeg er glad i å reise rundt om i verden. Alt fra korte turer i skandinavia til lengre turer til fjerne strøk. Dette kan være alt fra enkel ryggsekk til overdådig luksus. Alt etter som hva jeg ønsker å oppnå med turen.

Jeg liker å dra på museer, teater, utstillinger, show og konserter. Det skjer mye spennende både i og utenfor Oslo.
Jeg liker å lage mat og er veldig glad i asiatisk mat, spesielt thai. Gjerne litt sterk.
Jeg er en rolig person som liker å kunne slappe av og ha det litt stille rundt meg innimellom. Men syns det er veldig hygelig å treffe andre over et glass vin eller annet godt i rolige omgivelser.

Som vert vil jeg selvsagt stille opp å prøve å hjelpe til med det som måtte ønskes hjelp til. Alt fra praktiske råd om nærområdet, til hvordan få booket billetter på teater, kino etc.

host_about:
Hi!

I'm a little spontaneous norwegian  girl who loves to travel and meet new people. Usually I spend most my winters snowboarding, working and studying, while I use my summers to travel as much as possible. Other than I'm a creative little goof, who tries to make it as a graphic designer.

I've visited a lot of countries and can't really choose only one favorite destination, but I gotta say that Greenland is one of the most special places I've ever traveled to. I've never been a big fan of fishing (manly because I never catch any fishes), but up in Greenland you can catch a fish every second minute, I LOVE IT! And the nature, its just amazing!!! 
Other than that I've spent a couple of seasons snowboarding in Big Bear, California, which I miss pretty much every day. 

I probably got the widest specter when it comes to music, but I mainly listen to hip hop (old and new,everything from Wu-Tang to ILoveMakonnen), Future Island, Youth Lagoon, Mr Little Jeans, Bob Dylan, Tame Impala, Blind Pilot, Beach House, The Doors etc. 
Other than that I'm a huge Adventure Time fan, I've seen all ten season of Friends countless times, and probably way too many other series. I can't really pick a favorite movie, cause to be honest thats impossible, but I'll try to tell you my top ten if we ever cross paths. 

So at last, if you let me be a guest in your home, I'll respect it like its my grandparents house. I'm tidy and quiet, but also fun and social. I love making banana or bacon pancakes, and I would be happy to make them for any of my host of course. Sometimes I can be a little shy, but I usually forget it after a short half hour :-)
